# kion_aws_cloudformation_template (Resource)

Manages a Kion Cft.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_aws_cloudformation_template" "example" {
  # Required
  name    = "example"
  policy  = "example"
  regions = []

  # Optional
  # description            = "example"
  # owner_user_group_ids   = []
  # owner_user_ids         = []
  # region                 = "example"
  # sns_arns               = "example"
  # tags = [{
  #   tag_key   = "example"
  #   tag_value = "example"
  # }]
  # template_parameters    = "example"
  # termination_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Cloudformation template in the application.
- `policy` (String) Body of the CloudFormation template in JSON or YAML.
- `regions` (Set of String) List of the AWS regions where the CloudFormation template applies.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Cloudformation template in the application.
- `owner_user_group_ids` (Set of Number) List of groups IDs who will own the CloudFormation template. Is required if no user IDs are listed.
- `owner_user_ids` (Set of Number) List of user IDs who will own the CloudFormation template. Is required if no group IDs are listed.
- `region` (String) DEPRECATED! USE THE regions FIELD.
AWS region where the CloudFormation template applies.
- `sns_arns` (String) List of comma separated AWS SNS ARNs that will trigger once the CFT is done applying.
- `tags` (Attributes List) AWS Stack Tags used in this role when accessing the AWS console. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `template_parameters` (String) List of CloudFormation parameters in a JSON array.
- `termination_protection` (Boolean) Sets the termination protection status for this CFT.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) CloudFormation template ID.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `tag_key` (String) Key of the stack tag.
- `tag_value` (String) Value of the stack tag.
